experiment: action_future (action-conditioned future prediction from an RGB history)
registered_local: 2026-10-20 (before any result of this variant; user request of 2026-10-20 ~11:00 KST)
relation_to_frozen_method: A separate pretraining variant. method-frozen-v1 (C + D0 + M3D, 200k) is unchanged and remains the method; this variant changes exactly two things: the prediction objective (history -> current + two future frames) and access to recorded future actions in the decoder's dynamic displacement heads. Any difference therefore cannot be attributed to future prediction alone.

definition.encoder_input: RGB frames (t-2k, t-k, t) of one camera (unchanged encoder architecture and RL-time input contract)
definition.targets: frames (t, t+k, t+2k) of the 6 training cameras; depth and Gaussian-space 3D motion (M3D) targets rebased to this window
definition.decoder: current-time (t) Gaussians independent of actions; dynamic-group displacements t->t+k from (feats, emb(actions[t:t+k])) and t+k->t+2k from (feats, emb(actions[t:t+2k]), predicted mu(t+k)); two-layer MLP heads, zero-initialised outputs; shared prefix MLP 61->128->64 (12 x 4 actions, 12 validity entries, elapsed time = valid actions / 12); actions outside each prefix removed before padding
definition.actions: recorded actions[t:t+2k] (4, 8 or 12 per sample); collector convention verified: action[i] takes observation i to i+1 (s4d/data/metaworld/collect.py); not divided by the RL action repeat
definition.information_boundaries: encoder inputs, its tube-masking motion score (history frames only) and the synthetic-view invariance positives use the history window; render, depth, synthetic-render and 3D-motion targets use the target window; no teacher forcing; self-render consistency refused under this objective (off in the frozen recipe anyway)
definition.unchanged: static/dynamic Gaussian allocation (768x8 + 256x8), renderer, non-position attributes, loss weights, temporal ramp, synthetic views (2 per sample, positives + render targets), D0 depth with far mask, M3D, InfoNCE 1.0, consistency 0.5, visibility, 200k steps, seed 0, batch 16, LR schedule
definition.eligible_windows: anchors need t-2k >= 0 and t+2k <= length-1 for every k: per episode and stride length-24 windows vs length-12 for the original method (hammer validation: 0.944 of the original count)
definition.rl_protocol: unchanged registered protocol: frozen exported encoder, RL encoder config 'splatter4d', DrM 1M agent steps, seeds 2000-2002, evaluation every 10k agent steps with 240 episodes (120 training, 80 held-out, 40 moving cameras); decoder and action branch discarded for RL

technical_gate_hammer_and_pick_place.G1_implementation: full suite passes with the variant tests (alignment for k in {2,4,6}; actions[t:t+2k] in order and zero beyond; history-only masking score; current-time Gaussians unchanged when future actions change; first displacement unchanged when only second-interval actions change; padding invariance; encoder output unchanged when target-side fields or actions change; gradients reach encoder and action branch) and the same checks on real data and on the trained checkpoints
technical_gate_hammer_and_pick_place.G2_stability: smoke runs on both tasks with finite losses, gradients and outputs; 200k pretraining completes on both tasks without non-finite events; mean training loss over the last 10k steps below the mean over steps 1k-10k
technical_gate_hammer_and_pick_place.G3_prediction: on held-out validation episodes (strides 2 and 6, mean of the two), with correct actions at the 200k checkpoint: (a) moving-region PSNR at t+2k at least 0.5 dB above the persistence reference (same model, zero displacement); (b) relative 3D end-point error of the predicted t->t+2k displacement <= 0.8 (1.0 = no motion predicted); (c) both better than the step-0 evaluation. Shuffled and reversed actions are reported descriptively (expected: worse than correct actions)
technical_gate_hammer_and_pick_place.G4_rl_pipeline: frozen-encoder DrM runs start, evaluate and log finite success/return; no RL-performance requirement relative to the frozen method
technical_gate_hammer_and_pick_place.expansion_rule: if G1-G3 pass on both tasks and G4 shows valid evaluations, register and run the remaining six tasks with the identical definition, budgets, seeds and protocol (no task-specific tuning); hammer and pick-place runs are reused. If a gate fails: diagnose and repair the implementation, preserve the failed attempt, document the change; never tune toward RL results.

reporting: RL: success and return curves vs agent steps; last-5, final, normalised AUC with 95% CIs (established procedures), per task and aggregate (IQM), training / held-out / moving cameras separately. Prediction: current and future frames separately (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, depth error, 3D displacement error, moving-region metrics). Disclose pretraining time, GPU-hours, model size, action supervision and the eligible-window difference.
